_about: Where each graded plate's portrait crop sits in its 16:9 frame, written by tools/art/grade.py (the five plates graded before it wrote this file were measured from their shipped crops). loop_x is the object-position, in percent, that puts the 16:9 living loop over the same part of the frame as the portrait still on a phone (390 by 844, the still at 62 percent); tools/site/assemble_home.py writes it on each plate as --lx.
